svg.aria-label: The crew: /pya sends 8 specialist security agents at once. The three bots at the orchestrator console fling a brief to every agent and all progress bars run in parallel. The mode menu then shows quick, diff for pull request review, and focus on one agent, plus optional compliance mapping.
